props.stem: A short, realistic situation told in two sentences. A colleague asks you for help with a task you know well. **Which step of the method comes first?**

options.text: Choose the tool you used last time
options.feedback: Tempting and quick, yet it skips what makes this case different: look first.

options.text: Look at the situation with your colleague
options.feedback: Yes. Looking first tells you which building block fits, and often shows the answer.

options.text: Share the result with the whole team
options.feedback: Sharing comes last, once you know what worked. For now there is nothing to share.
